signal: Pathlock announced a global strategic partnership with NTT DATA Business Solutions in June 2026 to deliver managed SAP cybersecurity services worldwide.

email.subject1: coverage for the NTT DATA push
email.body1:
Jason, saw Pathlock just launched a global partnership with NTT DATA Business Solutions for managed SAP cybersecurity services.

A push like that usually creates more in-region accounts than the team can cover before momentum fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Pathlock off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jason, quick follow-up for Pathlock.

New alliance motion usually means pipeline expectations jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jason, last bit of proof for Pathlock.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other enterprise security vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jason, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up a new partner motion is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional SAP-security motion? I'll tailor it to Pathlock either way.
